all.src: Short call delta ~0.50; long calls delta 0.15-0.25.
Package must open for a net credit or a debit <= 5% of (long strike - short strike).
Max loss (width*100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity (tighter than the 1x2 because the valley is wider and more likely to be reached).
OI >= 1000 on the long strike (you need triple quantity), quoted size >= 30.

management.src: Time stop: close at 30 DTE, not 21 -- the extra long option makes late-cycle theta twice as damaging.

exits.src: Flat by 15:45 ET on expiration day.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: short call ITM at 15:30 ET on expiry day -> close the whole package immediately.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: short call ITM with extrinsic < $0.10 on any day -> close that session.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before ex-dividend whenever the short call is ITM and extrinsic < 1.5 * dividend.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before ex-dividend whenever the short call is ITM and extrinsic < 1.5 * dividend.
Mandatory close at 30 DTE absent a live catalyst.
